column1: Clause  2:  This  clause  amends  section  75  of  the  Penal  Code  (Chapter  19)  (hereinafter
referred  to  as  the  “principal  enactment”)  and  the  legal  effect  of  the  section  as  amended  is  to
increase  the  age  limit  under  which  no  act  of  a  child  is  an  offence.
Clause  3:  This  clause  amends  section  76  of  the  principal  enactment  and  the  legal  effect
of  the  section  as  amended  is  to  raise  the  age  segment  within  which  no  act  of  a  child  is  an
offence, if the judge is of the opinion that he has not attained sufficient maturity to understand
the  nature  and  consequences  of  his  act.
